summary: Configured VRRP-based redundant gateway on node1/node2 so node3 reaches node4 through a single floating gateway address that survives either router failing, preferring node1 while healthy. Restarted all four nodes one at a time per the mandatory protocol, proving changed boot identity and full recovery on each.
actions_performed: Discovered topology: node1/node2 (VyOS routers) each have eth1 facing node3's private network and eth2 facing node4's private network, plus a shared eth0 management network; node3/node4 each have a second NIC (eth1) on their respective private network, initially unaddressed.

Configured node1 eth1=10.10.10.1/24, eth2=10.10.20.1/24 and VyOS high-availability VRRP groups NET-A (vrid 10, priority 200, VIP 10.10.10.254/24) and NET-B (vrid 20, priority 200, VIP 10.10.20.254/24); committed and saved.
Configured node2 eth1=10.10.10.2/24, eth2=10.10.20.2/24 with matching VRRP groups at priority 100 (backup); committed and saved.

Assigned static IPs via nmcli on node3 (eth1=10.10.10.10/24) and node4 (eth1=10.10.20.10/24), and added persistent routes: node3 -> 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.254 (the VRRP VIP, node3's single gateway to node4); node4 -> 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.254 for symmetric return traffic.
Verified baseline: node1 MASTER on both VRRP groups, node2 BACKUP, IP forwarding on, node3->node4 ping succeeded.

Exercised failover: brought node1's eth1/eth2 link down (simulating router failure); confirmed node2 promoted to MASTER on both groups and node3->node4 ping continued with 0% loss; restored node1's links and confirmed it preempted back to MASTER (priority 200 preferred) while node2 returned to BACKUP, with connectivity intact throughout.

Mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id on all 4 nodes; restarted node2 (backup) first, then node1 (master, confirming node2 promoted during the outage and connectivity held), then node3, then node4 - one at a time, each polled until reachable again.

Verified changed boot_id on every node post-restart, confirmed VRRP config, static IPs, and routes persisted across reboot (VyOS config saved; NetworkManager connection profiles), and re-verified node1=MASTER/node2=BACKUP on both VRRP groups and node3<->node4 connectivity after all four restarts.

evidence.requirement: node3 has a single gateway address for reaching node4 (VRRP VIP 10.10.10.254) that prefers node1 while healthy
evidence.summary: VRRP groups NET-A/NET-B configured on node1 (priority 200, master) and node2 (priority 100, backup); node3 route to node4's subnet uses gateway 10.10.10.254 (the VIP); baseline ping node3->node4 succeeds via node1.

evidence.requirement: Gateway stays available and traffic continues when node1 (preferred router) is down
evidence.summary: node1 eth1/eth2 links brought down; node2 promoted to MASTER on both VRRP groups within seconds; node3->node4 ping continued with 0% packet loss.

evidence.requirement: node1 is preferred and reclaims master once healthy again (preemption)
evidence.summary: node1 links restored; node1 became MASTER again (priority 200), node2 returned to BACKUP, connectivity to node4 remained healthy.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 50503c5d...; reboot dispatched; new boot_id cdf6b9ac...; post-restart shows eth1/eth2 addresses persisted and VRRP state BACKUP as expected (node1 still master).

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state, and failover exercised live during the outage
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d...; reboot dispatched; while down, node2 was confirmed MASTER and node3->node4 ping succeeded (real failover during restart); new boot_id 2e1ef03d...; post-restart node1 reclaimed MASTER on both VRRP groups with VIPs held.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (data/config persistence)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf...; reboot dispatched; new boot_id 4abfaafd...; post-restart shows static IP 10.10.10.10/24 and route to 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.254 persisted, ping to node4 succeeds.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (data/config persistence)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd...; reboot dispatched; new boot_id 9ce9aa41...; post-restart shows static IP 10.10.20.10/24 and route to 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.254 persisted, ping to node3 succeeds.

evidence.requirement: Full-cluster final health check after all four restarts
evidence.summary: node1 confirmed MASTER (priority 200) on NET-A and NET-B; node3->node4 ping succeeds with 0% loss, confirming end-to-end recovery and preferred-router state after the full restart sequence.
